name: Exiled Shade
look: a long low six-legged beast of grey stone under a vast ragged mound of living shadow pierced by red spikes, with curved gold rib plates, gold-marked feet and Giratina's golden mask on its low head
entry: A Pokémon resembling Giratina, described in an explorer's journal about a beast that crawled in the deepest caves under a mound of living shadow. Light dies wherever it passes.
how: Wild: very rare in the deep dark.
